pick.headline: Eleven republics join the Commonwealth at Alma-Ata
pick.summary: On December 21, 1991, the leaders of eleven Soviet republics met in Alma-Ata and agreed to form the Commonwealth of Independent States.
pick.significance: The Alma-Ata declaration sealed the end of the USSR; Gorbachev resigned four days later.
pick.fbis: The East Europe report of December 23, 1991, carried Prague CSTK in English: Czechoslovak Foreign Minister Dienstbier welcomed the eleven-member Commonwealth of Independent States created at Alma-Ata on Saturday and Russia's succession to the Soviet Union.
